Blink Marketing is a real estate marketing membership built by agents. Starting at $49/month, you get access to pre-made Canva templates for social media, email newsletters, postcards, and pop-bys. There is no video editing, no client dashboard, and no content approval workflow.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
Here is how they compare across every category that matters.

Blink gives you video scripts and Reel templates, but zero video production. You film it, you edit it, you post it.
VEXI edits your videos for you.

Blink has no approval workflow. Content posts automatically from shared templates — you cannot review or approve before it goes live.
Blink has no dashboard to manage content, view analytics, or track your pipeline. You log in to grab templates and that is it.
Blink offers no free trial. You pay before you see anything.

But content comes from a shared library, auto-posting only covers Facebook and Instagram, there is no video editing, and there is no client dashboard or approval workflow.
Built for people who want it done right.
Is Blink Marketing a done-for-you service?

Only partially. Blink’s Level 1 plan is entirely DIY — you get templates and post everything yourself. Levels 2 and 3 add auto-posting to Facebook and Instagram only (5x per week), but the content comes from a shared template library, not custom local graphics designed for your brand.
Does Blink Marketing include video editing?
No. Blink provides video scripts and Reel templates, but no video production or editing service. You film and edit everything yourself.
Which platforms does Blink Marketing post to?
Blink’s auto-posting feature (Levels 2 and 3 only) covers Facebook and Instagram. There is no posting to LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, or X.
Does Blink Marketing have a client dashboard?

No. Blink does not offer a client dashboard, content approval workflow, or visual content calendar. You log in to access templates and resources, but there is no way to review, approve, or track content before it posts.
